coverage_policy.scope: every git-tracked file in this repository
coverage_policy.means: these bytes were present at this SHA-256
coverage_policy.does_not_mean: that the file is a governed scientific authority, a release artifact, or evidence that anything in it is correct
coverage_policy.authority_register: AUTHORITIES.md / authorities.json answer 'what is governed'; this manifest answers 'what bytes exist'
coverage_policy.exclusion_reason: final_manifest.json cannot hash itself; manifest_hash.txt is its detached hash, written after the manifest is finalized

self_hash_policy: DETACHED MANIFEST HASHING. final_manifest.json cannot contain its own hash; manifest_hash.txt records it and is not listed in files[].
